Model-assisted or learned planning; live model calls; paid benchmarks.
Rewriting the BB-062 research benchmark script or its delivered evidence.

constraints: New strategies are separate planner factories with the delivered {plan, execute} interface in a new module; retrieval-planner.js is not edited.
The ablation uses deterministic fixture lexical/symbol clients over an exact git snapshot and the BB-088 graph client; every arm goes through SourceCatalog validation.
Ground truth is derived mechanically from component-registry contractRefs -> sourceRoots at the snapshot, not labeled by the Worker.

invariants: Every strategy preserves reservation, EXACT/CURRENT, provenance and budget semantics of DETERMINISTIC_V1.
The decision is computed by a preregistered deterministic reducer; non-discriminating arms yield INCONCLUSIVE.

architectureDecisions: D1 — New module packages/oracle/src/planning-strategies.js exporting createFusionRetrievalPlanner({catalog, base}) (RRF_FUSION_V1) and createGraphExpandedRetrievalPlanner({catalog, base, graphProviderId}) (GRAPH_EXPANDED_V1); both return {plan, execute, strategyId} and delegate reservation to the delivered base planner.

D2 — RRF_FUSION_V1: executes every reserved work unit for an evidence instead of stopping at the first successful provider, then orders candidates by reciprocal-rank fusion score 1/(60+rank) summed across providers, ties by source itemRef; accepted count stays within the reserved item budget.

D3 — GRAPH_EXPANDED_V1: runs the base plan; when unreserved budget remains and a CONTEXT_GRAPH provider is registered, adds one TRAVERSE_GRAPH IMPORTS hop anchored at the top base candidate's itemRef; graph-derived items keep AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE provenance and are validated by SourceCatalog.
D4 — Arms: A0 DETERMINISTIC_V1, A1 lexical-only and A2 symbol-only (delivered unavailableProviders option), A3 RRF_FUSION_V1, A4 GRAPH_EXPANDED_V1.

D5 — Cohort: scripts/oracle-context-intelligence/planner-ablation-cohort.json freezes snapshotRef, corpus roots packages/oracle/src and packages/agentic-system/src, and queries generated from docs/blackboard/component-registry.json: for each component, query = contractRefs joined by space, relevant = its sourceRoots that are concrete .js files existing at the snapshot. Components with no concrete relevant file are excluded with reason. The cohort digest is recorded before strategies run.

D6 — Fixture clients: lexical client = deterministic token-overlap scoring over snapshot file contents; symbol client = exported-identifier index over snapshot files; both return snapshot-bound candidates with REVISION validators. They are fixtures, stated as such, not Zoekt/LSP.

D7 — Metrics per arm/query: Recall@k and MRR with k = budget.maxItems (3), materialized bytes, provider calls, unresolved reasons. Discrimination check: if every arm selects identical ordered itemRefs for every query, outcome INCONCLUSIVE_NON_DISCRIMINATING.

D8 — Preregistered reducer: a candidate arm is RECOMMENDED when for every query Recall@k >= A0, mean Recall@k - A0 >= 0.05, and mean materialized bytes <= 1.25 x A0; the best such arm by mean Recall then MRR is returned as RECOMMEND_<strategyId>; otherwise KEEP_DETERMINISTIC_V1. Thresholds are constants in the cohort file.

D9 — Harness scripts/oracle-context-intelligence/planner-ablation.mjs --snapshot <sha> writes ORACLE_PLANNER_ABLATION_V1 {cohortDigest, arms, perQuery, decision}; --mode validate re-reduces a recorded report and must reproduce the decision.

D10 — Evidence basis: the executed continuation probe shows the delivered BB-062 benchmark does not use the planner, gives identical aggregate recall for three arms and reports structuralPrimary true despite BB-062 D15.
implementationSlices: P1 — Cohort + fixture clients [PL1]: generate and commit planner-ablation-cohort.json per D5 with its digest, and implement D6 fixture clients inside the harness.
P2 — Strategies [PL2]: implement D1-D3; unit tests prove identical reservation/budget/currentness failures to DETERMINISTIC_V1 and correct fusion/expansion ordering.

P3 — Harness + reducer [PL1, PL3]: implement D4, D7-D9; test runs the harness at `git rev-parse HEAD`, checks discrimination detection on a forced-identical fixture, and re-reduces the report deterministically.

P4 — Living truth [PL3]: export strategies, add docs/living/system/oracle/planner.md with the recorded decision, fixture-client limits and NOT_EVALUATED model-assisted planning; run test:oracle and npm run verify.

negativeVerificationCases: An arm that bypasses SourceCatalog validation or reads working-tree files fails the ablation test.
A strategy that weakens EXACT/CURRENT, drops provenance or exceeds reserved items/bytes fails the strategy parity tests.
A cohort query whose relevant set is edited by hand (cohort digest mismatch with regenerated cohort) fails the ablation test.
Forced identical selections across all arms must yield INCONCLUSIVE_NON_DISCRIMINATING, never RECOMMEND.
A candidate with any per-query recall below A0 must not be recommended even if its mean is higher.
Re-reducing a recorded report in validate mode with a different decision fails.
Changing the default createRetrievalPlanner behavior or editing retrieval-planner.js fails repository scope verification.
